bash -c 
export ANARI_LIBRARY_PATH=/var/lib/jenkins/moat/projects/anari-visionaray/src/build/install/lib
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$ANARI_LIBRARY_PATH:/var/lib/jenkins/moat/_deps/anari-install/lib:/opt/rocm/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}

# Run 8 stability passes
PASS=0; FAIL=0
for i in $(seq 1 8); do
  result=$(HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 VOL_NEAREST=1 /var/lib/jenkins/moat/agent_space/anari_hip_validate visionaray_hip 2>&1)
  if echo "$result" | grep -q 'OVERALL: PASS'; then
    PASS=$((PASS+1))
    if [ $i -eq 1 ]; then echo "$result"; fi
  else
    FAIL=$((FAIL+1))
    echo "Run $i FAILED:"
    echo "$result"
  fi
done
echo "Stability: $PASS/8 PASS, $FAIL/8 FAIL"
bash -c cd agent_space && HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ANARI_LIBRARY_PATH='.' timeout 120 ./anari_win_validate_gfx1201.exe visionaray_hip visionaray
